description: This file defines the LogWrapper class that implements logging functionality by wrapping Android's native Log class, enabling logs to be potentially chained and extended.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class implementing the LogNode interface, wrapping Android's Log utility to facilitate logging with optional chaining.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode for chain forwarding.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs messages to Android's log system, optionally appending exception stacks and forwarding to the next node.
